Description: Prevent Hightown event bosses from repeating their nested five-roll armor bundle five times.
Restore the native shared boss-extra rewards, including the normal offense-or-defense ring roll, to Hightown event bosses.
Restore the native shared boss-extra rewards, including the normal offense-or-defense ring roll, to Midtown event bosses.
Restore the native shared boss-extra rewards, including the normal offense-or-defense ring roll, to Industry City event bosses.
